India's Cricket Team Arrives in Zimbabwe for T20 Series

The Indian cricket team arrived at Harare Sports Club in Zimbabwe on Tuesday for the first T20 International (T20I) match against Zimbabwe. The team, led by Rohit Sharma, is scheduled to play two matches in Zimbabwe. The first match is set to begin on Wednesday. India's bowling coach, Bharat Arjun, has expressed concerns about the pitch conditions at Harare Sports Club. The Zimbabwe Cricket Board has assured that the pitch will be suitable for cricket. The Indian team has been training hard to prepare for the series.
